attributes.board_name: Arkansas Board of Animal Health (veterinary licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by accredited/approved veterinary colleges, AAHA, AVMA and its recognized specialty organizations, local/state/regional/national veterinary associations, NAVTA and its specialty academies, AAVSB RACE, or USDA; others by Board pre-approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE waived for the renewal period in which the technician graduated and was certified.
rules.alternatives: Board may exempt or extend for sickness or other justifiable reason.
rules.audit_note: Keep records 3 years; Board may audit.
rules.notes: Min. 8 h medicine and surgery; max 4 h nonscientific. At least 6 h in person or live webinar; max 6 h prerecorded online. Veterinary technician specialists need 8 extra advanced hours yearly. Active renewal needs a supervising veterinarian on file.
rules.rule_quote: (c)(1) Veterinary technicians and veterinary technologists must earn twelve (12) continuing education hours each year to be eligible for certificate renewal.
